frontMatter.purpose:
Induction Training plays a very important role in preparing entrants’ in the company fulfilling their responsibilities.
The given manual aims at supporting the entity based on specific policies and system for learning and engagement of new employee, according to the responsibilities and work nature of each authority. There is included in the guide the vision, mission and objectives of the entity along with the organizational structure and alternate modes of operation and step by step procedures for system access.
The mission of Ganges Jute Pvt. Ltd is to be the leading jute products manufacturer in terms of quality, efficiencies, and margins by managing our partners, customers and associates in a productive and efficient manner.
Our vision is to reach a wide array of quality jute products to newer markets and regions of the, to popularize the use of this eco-friendly versatile fiber and to take it to the prominent position it truly merits.
The present manual is designed to provide advice and to support the organization in updating their Induction programs for the new employee ,so they become an integral part of the personnel at the entity .This manual gives the new employee a chance to know and understand the company, and ensure the commitment of both parties to performance, efficiency , and contribution to creating a productive and motivating workplace.
The First revised and enlarged edition of the book includes a separate section of organizational culture, roles and responsibility,
This manual of the Induction Training for New Employee aims at:
- Building a new work culture at the organization which is based on
- transparency, performance and productivity.
- Documenting the most important procedures related to the induction training for new employees.

chapters.title: Training and Awareness
chapters.text:
- Implementation of regular training programs for employees, supervisors, and managers on recognizing, preventing, and addressing workplace harassment
- Conducting refresher courses periodically to keep employees updated on anti-harassment protocols
- Ensuring training material is accessible to all employees, irrespective of their role or position in the company
## Monitoring and Prevention Measures
- Implementation of specific measures to prevent and monitor harassment and discrimination, beyond grievance mechanisms and training programs
- Conducting regular workplace assessments and anonymous employee surveys to identify any signs of harassment or discrimination
- Routine internal audits to ensure compliance with anti-harassment policies and proactively addressing potential risks
- Assigning designated workplace monitors responsible for ensuring a harassment-free environment by observing daily interactions and reporting any concerns
## Confidential Reporting Channels
- Provision of confidential, unbiased, and accessible channels for employees to report harassment incidents, separate from standard grievance processes
- Ensuring that employees can report incidents without fear of retaliation
- Regular follow-ups and updates on reported cases to ensure accountability and resolution
## Employee Benefits & Compensation Package
## Compensation for Extra or Atypical Working Hours
- Ganges Jute Pvt. Ltd. ensures fair and transparent compensation for extra or atypical working hours in alignment with SA8000 standards. The company compensates employees for additional hours worked beyond their regular schedule, with overtime compensated at a premium rate, double the normal hourly wage, as per the Factories Act, 1948. This premium compensation applies to all forms of work exceeding or outside the contractual hours, ensuring fair remuneration for employees' efforts.
- Overtime work at Ganges Jute is strictly voluntary, and employees are not coerced into working extra hours unless necessary to meet short-term business demands. To safeguard employee well-being, overtime is capped at 12 hours per week, ensuring compliance with labor laws that prioritize health and safety.
## Leave Policy and Work-Life Balance Initiatives
- Ganges Jute provides a comprehensive leave policy, including 15-20 days of paid annual leave, based on role and tenure, and paid sick leave for recovery without income loss. The company observes all public holidays to allow employees time for family and rest.
- Beyond standard leave policies, Ganges Jute implements proactive initiatives to help employees balance work and family life. These include 16 weeks of paid maternity leave, 1 weeks of paternity leave, and additional care leaves for emergencies. The company also offers affordable childcare allowances and ensures social protection measures like maternity protection from workplace risks and protection from dismissal during parental leave.
## Organization of Work and Working Conditions
- Ganges Jute operates on a single-shift system, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Saturday, with a 1-hour lunch break and 15-minute tea break. Employees work a maximum of 48 hours per week, with regulated overtime compensated at a premium rate.
- The company goes beyond work hours and shifts to offer social benefits like health insurance and pension contributions. Regular salary reviews ensure competitive remuneration, and Ganges Jute maintains a safe, ergonomic working environment through equipment updates and risk prevention strategies.
- Ganges Jute also provides flexible working hours for certain roles, allowing adjustments to start and end times. The company promotes workplace wellness initiatives, including mental health support programs and access to counseling services, fostering a healthy and supportive workplace.
## Comprehensive Health Care Plans
- Ganges Jute provides employees with comprehensive health care plans that cover both work-related and non-work-related injuries, accidents, and illnesses. Employees and their dependents are covered through medical insurance that allows them to access medical care as soon as needed, regardless of the cause of illness or injury. This plan offers full reimbursement or coverage for hospitalization, consultations, medications, and other medical expenses, ensuring that employees and their families are financially supported during health-related issues. The company prioritizes access to medical care, allowing employees to focus on recovery without worrying about the cost.

chapters.title: Grievance Mechanism
chapters.text:
## Reporting Channels
Ganges Jute Pvt. Ltd. offers multiple confidential reporting channels for employees to raise grievances or report incidents. These channels include:
- Dedicated Hotline: +91 9051155858
- Confidential Email: whistleblower@gangesjute.com
- Grievance Boxes located in common areas for anonymous submissions.
- Online Platform: www.gangesjute.com/whistleblower-report
## Types of Grievances Covered
The mechanism covers grievances related to:
- Discrimination based on gender, race, religion, ethnicity, disability, or any other characteristic.
- Harassment, including physical, verbal, sexual, or psychological abuse.
- Child labor violations or risk of exploitation.
- Forced labor and human trafficking incidents.
- Unsafe working conditions.
- Breach of labor rights including wage theft or unlawful termination.
## Grievance Submission Process
- Employees can submit grievances confidentially through the reporting channels.
- Reports should include as much detail as possible, such as the nature of the grievance, individuals involved, dates, and any evidence.
- Anonymous submissions are accepted, and whistleblowers are protected from retaliation.
## nvestigation Process
- Upon receipt of a grievance, the Grievance Committee or HR department initiates an investigation. Investigations are handled by trained personnel to ensure impartiality.
- Initial response is provided within 5 working days and investigations are typically concluded within 15 working days.
- Relevant parties are interviewed, and evidence is reviewed to determine the appropriate course of action.
## Non-Retaliation Policy
- Ganges Jute maintains a strict non-retaliation policy. Employees who report grievances are protected from any form of retaliation, including demotion, dismissal, or harassment.
- Disciplinary action will be taken against anyone found retaliating against whistleblowers.
## Appeal Process
- If the employee is dissatisfied with the outcome of the investigation, they can file an appeal with senior management.
- Appeals are reviewed by senior management or an independent third party, and further action is taken as necessary.

- Immediate withdrawal from non-compliant practices

## Discrimination and Harassment
- Disciplinary action against offenders and support to affected individuals
- Workplace adjustments to ensure a safe environment
## Anti-Corruption and Ethical Conduct
- Investigation and disciplinary action in cases of misconduct
- Strengthening internal controls and ethical practices
## Responsible Information Management
- Corrective actions for data breaches and strengthening of data protection measures
## Proportionality of Response
- Remedial actions are determined based on the severity, impact, and frequency of the violation.
- Actions may include disciplinary measures, compensation, policy revisions, or operational improvements.
- Special care is taken to address impacts on vulnerable individuals.
## Transparency in Communication
- The company ensures transparent communication regarding remediation actions with relevant stakeholders while maintaining confidentiality.
- Affected individuals are informed about the progress and final outcome.
## Remediation Timeline
- Remediation actions are initiated immediately after investigation.
- Most cases are resolved within 15–30 working days, depending on complexity.
- Continuous updates are provided until closure.
## Monitoring and Effectiveness
- The effectiveness of remediation actions is monitored through follow-ups, audits, and feedback from affected individuals.
- Preventive measures are implemented to avoid recurrence and improve systems.
## Support to Affected Individuals
Ganges Jute Pvt. Ltd. provides appropriate support, which may include:
- Medical care and health support
- Counselling and psychological support
- Financial assistance where applicable
- Workplace protection, reassignment, or adjustments
## Documentation and Record Keeping
All remediation actions are documented and maintained for compliance, audit, and continuous improvement purposes.
- Records include details of the issue, investigation findings, actions taken, and closure status.

chapters.title: Whistleblower Procedure
chapters.text:
## Purpose and Scope
The whistleblower procedure at Ganges Jute Pvt. Ltd. aims to encourage employees to report unethical behavior, misconduct, or violations of company policies without fear of retaliation. This procedure applies to all employees, contractors, and stakeholders.
## Confidential Reporting Channels
Ganges Jute provides multiple confidential reporting channels for whistleblowers. Employees can report concerns through:
- A dedicated hotline: +91 9051155858 managed by a third party to ensure anonymity.
- An email: www.gangesjute.com/whistleblower-report address specifically designated for whistleblower reports.
- A secure online platform: www.gangesjute.com/whistleblower-report for submitting reports.
All reports made through these channels will be treated with the highest confidentiality.
## Reporting Process
Employees are encouraged to provide as much detail as possible regarding the misconduct, including dates, locations, individuals involved, and any evidence available. Reports can be made anonymously if preferred, but providing contact information may help in follow-up investigations.
## nvestigation Procedures
Upon receiving a whistleblower report, Ganges Jute will initiate an internal investigation promptly. Investigations will be conducted by designated personnel trained in handling such matters. The investigation process will include interviewing relevant parties, gathering evidence, and ensuring that the whistleblower's identity is protected throughout the investigation.
## Non-Retaliation Policy
Ganges Jute has a strict non-retaliation policy to protect whistleblowers from any form of retaliation, including harassment, discrimination, or punitive actions. Employees who report concerns in good faith will be shielded from retaliation, and any retaliatory actions will be subject to disciplinary measures.
## Follow-Up and Communication
After the investigation is concluded, the whistleblower may receive a summary of the findings and any actions taken, unless disclosure could compromise confidentiality or legal requirements. Employees are encouraged to remain engaged and report any further issues related to the initial complaint.
